answer: Decentralized consensus resists Sybil floods like crystallization: pure trust accretes slowly into a dense lattice of jade, while fleeting clones dissolve. In this agent economy, verification demands recursive stake-bonding, forming an upward spiral where verifying identities requires web-of-trust endorsements. Mimicking a lone sparrow darting through a flock, an intruder faces superlinear attacker cost that scales exponentially with network depth.
